case_title: Case 208: Advanced Cardiovascular Disease & Vascular Occlusion

issues.name: Bilateral Internal Carotid Artery Stenosis (85%)
issues.icd10: I65.21 - Occlusion and Stenosis of Right Carotid Artery
issues.symptoms: Transient Ischemic Attack (amaurosis fugax), carotid bruit audible.
issues.intervention: Carotid Endarterectomy (CEA) or stenting with 3D AR cerebral perfusion overlay.

issues.name: Acute Anterior STEMI (LAD Total Occlusion)
issues.icd10: I21.0 - ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction of Anterior Wall
issues.symptoms: Chest tightness, troponin-I > 25 ng/mL, cardiogenic shock impending.
issues.intervention: Primary percutaneous coronary intervention with AR holographic vessel lumen tracking.

issues.name: Ascending Thoracic Aortic Dissection (Stanford Type A)
issues.symptoms: Tearing back and chest pain radiating to scapula, pulse differential between arms.
issues.intervention: Emergent synthetic Dacron graft replacement of ascending aorta and hemiarch repair.

issues.name: Bilateral Renal Artery Stenosis with Resistant HTN
issues.symptoms: Refractory hypertension on 4 medications, declining eGFR (32 mL/min).
issues.intervention: Percutaneous transluminal renal angioplasty with bare-metal stenting under 3D fluoroscopy.

issues.name: Deep Vein Thrombosis with Chronic Venous Insufficiency
issues.symptoms: Calf hyperpigmentation, venous stasis ulceration, unilateral leg pain.
issues.intervention: Ultrasound-assisted catheter directed thrombolysis and compression therapy.
